definitions.explanation: To turn one's gaze in various directions to observe the surroundings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見回|みまわ}して⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}した→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I looked around the room searching for something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{辺|あた}り→辺り：01770_atari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見回|みまわ}すと、⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いなかった→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: When I looked around, there was no one there.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{不安|ふあん}そうに→不安：00836_fuan⟧⟦{周囲|しゅうい}→周囲：03206_shuui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見回|みまわ}した。
⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見回|みまわ}すと、⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着|つ}いて→着く：00680_tsuku⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: When I looked around the classroom, everyone was in their seats.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見回|みまわ}すと、⟦{遠|とお}く→遠く：01680_tooku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: When I surveyed the scenery from the top of the mountain, I could see the sea in the distance.

notes:
{見回|みまわ}す is a compound verb: ⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to see) + ⟦{回|まわ}す→回す：01158_mawasu⟧ (to turn around). It means to look around in all directions, scanning the surroundings.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Takes を for the area being surveyed: ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見回|みまわ}す

ASPECT (ている):
{見回|みまわ}している means "is looking around" (ongoing action).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{辺|あた}り→辺り：01770_atari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見回|みまわ}す: to look around the area
- ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見回|みまわ}す: to look around the room
- ⟦きょろきょろ→きょろきょろ：07514_kyorokyoro⟧{見回|みまわ}す: to look around restlessly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{見渡|みわた}す→見渡す：07169_miwatasu⟧: to survey, to look out over (wider panoramic view)
- ⟦{見回|みまわ}る→見回る：18267_mimawaru⟧: to patrol, to make rounds (walking around to check)
- ⟦{見|み}つめる→見つめる：04571_mitsumeru⟧: to gaze at (focused on one point, not scanning)
